name: Koisuru Otome to Shugo no Tate - Re:boot The "SHIELD-9"
original_name: 恋する乙女と守護の楯 Re:boot The "SHIELD-9"
source:
This is a remake of AXL’s 2007 title Koisuru Otome to Shugo no Tate, with new routes added for Yuuri and Setsuko. Senomoto Hisashi’s art has changed a bit over the years, while the cast has stayed pretty much the same aside from Yuuri (Nekoyashiki Mai). Of course, the graphics are now in widescreen full HD and compatible with Windows 10.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2020/03/26/march-2020-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
translation:
这是AXL 2007年的游戏《恋爱乙女》到《守护之塔》的重制版，为勇利和节子添加了新路线。多年来，濑本尚的艺术作品发生了一些变化，而除了勇利（猫屋敷麻衣）之外，演员阵容几乎保持不变。当然，图形现在是宽屏全高清并与Windows 10兼容。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2020/03/26/march-2020-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
